Metadata.Goal: 让 v3 unit bundle loader 投影 RuntimeInstance 与 Scope.runtime 绑定。
Metadata.Description: G2-T2：只做 parse-only loader/projection，不执行 runtime 代码。

TaskSpace.name: add-halfcode-runtime-instance-loader
TaskSpace.Description: Parse runtime domain and scope runtime bindings into loader output.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: RuntimeScopeBindingSpec is exported from contract root.

Task.name: Extend LoadedHalfcodeUnit output
Task.Description: Expose runtime and scopeRuntimeBindings on loaded units.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Existing loaded unit shape remains backward-compatible.

TaskGroup.name: Runtime parser
TaskGroup.Description: Parse Runtime and Scope binding documents.

Task.name: Parse RuntimeInstance
Task.Description: Read src/create/prototype/derive/config into RuntimeInstanceSpec and validate source exclusivity.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Loader returns RuntimeSpec instances for runtime domain.

Task.name: Parse Scope.runtime bindings
Task.Description: Read runtime/config/intents refs from Scope nodes.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Loader returns scopeRuntimeBindings with scope ids and refs.

Task.name: Collect dotted refs
Task.Description: Update loader ref-like scanner to include dotted schemes.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: effect.types:// and data.graph:// refs are seen by ref collection.

TaskGroup.name: Tests
TaskGroup.Description: Add support tests and run package test matrix.

Task.name: Add loader tests
Task.Description: Use in-memory bundle fixture to assert runtime projection and diagnostics.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Support tests cover RuntimeSpec and Scope.runtime projection.
